data.title: Cindy gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [Before purchasing](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4d159ab63171e3e14d2df8)

Before purchasing, you better know that you will only be dealing with a bot after your order. Their communications are ridiculous. You cannot even find a telephone number to reach an actual human. These AI sales companies need to lose sales from such a poor business model.

That all sounds like a normal company! Why do you not list a telephone number on your invoice, your emails or your website?!? When trying to reach any of those option you so proudly announce, you get directed to a list of stupid questions and answers. I was told by one of your “agents” that there is a backlog of responses that have not been answered because of your summer sale. Sounds like poor management all around. It took me 2 emails since 7/1 and multiple attempts to reach any human that took hours of my time to reach a human. Still no response to the email sent on the first. Buyers beware.

June 24, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Updated Jul 8, 2026

Hi Cindy,

Thank you for your feedback. I want to assure you that you were in contact with a live agent yesterday who provided updated tracking information. While our Customer support team does not have a live phone number, the agent who assisted you can call you back if you prefer that method of communication. Please let us know if you would like to discuss any feedback or concerns over the phone; we are happy to accommodate this. Thank you for your understanding!

Lulu and Georgia
